## First-time contributors

You do not need to sign anything before opening this pull request. If this is your first contribution,
the maintainer will reply with a permanent link to the exact version of
[`CLA.md`](https://github.com/shyoo/warmstart/blob/main/CLA.md) to sign. Please post the declaration
as a new pull-request comment rather than adding it to this editable description. Each person whose
work is included must sign from their own GitHub account.
